summaries.text:
Pathogen Reduction Act of 1994 - Title I: Amends the Federal Meat Inspection Act and the Poultry Products Inspection Act to direct the Secretary of Agriculture to establish procedures to reduce foodborne pathogen related illnesses, including: (1) tracing and recall authority; (2) civil penalties; (3) pathogen standards; and (4) import requirements.

Title II: Amends specified Federal laws with regard to related control of livestock or poultry disease, including quarantine, imports, and exports.
